description: dds<->dsterm version/capability handshake (FIXLIST #79), formalised as a versioned contract in #100. Pinned by BOTH repos: dsterm's status_body_matches_the_shared_contract drives status_body() against this file, dds's dsterm_status_contract_test drives DstermDiscoveryInfo.fromJson against it. protocol_version and min_client_protocol are STRINGS on the wire: shipped dds builds parse them with `as String?` and a numeric value would throw a TypeError there. Versioning rules live in contracts/CONTRACT.md.
